children: Brian Adams, an officer serving as Chief Legal Officer, sold shares of Kymera Therapeutics common stock on September 4, 2026. The reported transactions were sales executed to cover tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of restricted stock units. The transactions comprised three sales of common stock with weighted average prices of $115.55, $116.81 and $117.57 per share as reported in the Form 4 footnotes. The total reported sale amount was $744,297. After the reported transactions, Adams directly beneficially owns 50,254 shares of common stock.
